verdicts.effectivity_check: No such line exists in this proof. The proof produces only the determinism onset 'sigma_r = max_{c<r} N(c) - r =: M_{r-1} - r' and a finite state space; its single forward-looking bound is explicitly conjectural: 'which would give N(r) <= K·r by a one-line induction' — K is never computed and is conditional on unproven claim C0034. The computable recursion 'N(r)<=r+max(t_r,m_r)+q_r(m_r+1)^{m_r}' appears only in the Results-cited section as dependency C0024 (statement only; its Lemma P is not re-proven here). Conditional on C0024 the right-hand side is computable from the rows c < r, so effectivity of the project goal rides entirely on that dependency; this submission itself reasserts existence and reframes the problem rather than producing an evaluable constant.

verdicts.gap_description: The induction base is false at (r,a)=(0,0): there V''(0)=V'(0)=T_0=∅, so k_0 = mex_{>=0}(∅) = 0, but L_0 = B_0(0) = f(0,0) = 1 (ground truth f(0,0)=1, row 0 is live with B_0≡1). Machine (M) with 'mex over the non-negative integers' therefore spurious-terminates the live row 0 — equivalently (FR) fails exactly at q=0, because the shift-by-q reduction of mex over positive f-values needs q>=1. One-line repair: state Lemmas M/S for r>=1 (or q>=1) with row 0 (B_0≡1, N(0)=0) as base case; nothing else in the submission is affected. Second, cosmetic: the validation bullet 'machine (M) reproduces f(r+a,r)-(r+a) exactly, all rows r <= 300' is contradicted at r=0 and should read r=1..300.

verdicts.effectivity_check: Computable, not a reassertion of existence — but only via the cited dependency C0024, not via Lemma M/S alone. The constant is produced in: '(iii) u_r<=max(t_r,m_r)+q_r(m_r+1)^{m_r}; (iv) q_{r+1}<=q_r^2(r+2)^{r+1}. Hence N(r)<=r+max(t_r,m_r)+q_r(m_r+1)^{m_r} for live rows (stale rows similar with +1)'. Every right-hand quantity is a function of already-solved rows c<r only: m_r=1+max{B_c(a):c<r,a>=0} (max attained in the computable window [0,u_c+p_c) since row c is eventually p_c-periodic from u_c), U_r=max{u_c:c<r}, q_r=lcm{p_c:c<r}, t_r=max(U_r,r); each row's exact (u_c,p_c) is recovered inductively from these same bounds, so there is no circular dependence on any existential quantity, and N(r)<=F(r) for an explicit total computable F. Caveats: (1) F is doubly exponential in r (at r=500 the bound is a 907-digit integer; at r=1000 its decimal expansion has ~2^1000 digits), i.e. effective in the computability sense but not evaluable by hand at r=1000; (2) the derivation of (ii)/(iii) lives in C0024, whose proof is not part of this submission — I verified its inequalities numerically (0 failures) but could not audit its proof; (3) the submission's own lemmas only set up the machine and the onset σ_r, and the O(r) target is explicitly left as a conjecture (u_r-σ_r=O(1)), correctly not claimed as proven.
